entwurf.beschreibung: Claude’s new project format turns a conversation into AI threads. Each thread starts with the project’s files and instructions. Threads run in the cloud and stay active after you close your laptop. The system gathers, reviews, and compiles the outputs into a library. Like, share, and save to see how this changes your workflow.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Claude’s new project format turns a conversation into AI threads.
teile.szene: A dim office, a coder staring at a screen, lights flicker, the screen flashes a warning sign.

teile.name: Problem
teile.text: Each thread starts with the project’s files and instructions.
teile.szene: A crowded game dev conference, posters, people laughing, a banner reads “No Cloning Allowed.”

teile.name: Tool
teile.szene: A developer typing, the screen shows a checklist, a green tick appears.

teile.name: Steps
teile.text: Threads run in the cloud and stay active after you close your laptop.
teile.szene: A user clicking through a wizard, a progress bar fills up, a red alert pops up.

teile.name: Limitation
teile.text: The system gathers, reviews, and compiles the outputs into a library.
teile.szene: A lawyer in a suit reviewing a document, the screen shows legal text, a red “?” icon.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: Like, share, and save to see how this changes your workflow.
teile.szene: A triumphant developer raising a trophy, confetti falls, the screen says “Approved.”
